text: No, there was no tree-cover loss on this property in 2026. The latest observation from the Hansen Global Forest Change dataset (GFC-2025-v1.13) detected tree-cover loss in 2025, not 2026. The event covered 13.5 hectares (3.91% of the asset) and was corroborated by the JRC 2020 reference data, which confirmed 98% of the area was forested in 2020. No further observations or updates are available beyond 2025.
